items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: This is the one with Ernest Tapley, Banjo... I had a band of my own... I played all around in the various night club

ctx.x: I think it's around 22, I'd say 22 or 23.

Well, it was very early in the first period of Paramount. Inc. must have started with them right at the outset, didn't it? They had ink started with them just as soon as they started recording stuff on the south side. Yeah, yeah. Inc. must have been there very early. Well, I'll see what I can find. Where are your notes, Jasper? I'd like to go over those with the films. Who is on the record? Did you give Jasper that information? Oh, yeah. He has that. Ernest Tapley, huh? Banjo? Banjo. Where'd he come from?
He stayed on the south side, right at 28th and LaSalle at the time.
